body:
Small follow-up to d8d23ad's own real fix (backticks in ONBOARDING text were getting re-evaluated by a second shell layer when the whole command was handed to tmux as one inline string -- confirmed live, this exact bug had already fired on a real, in-flight session, corrupting its own onboarding prompt). The startup script written to /tmp was never cleaned up; it now self-deletes as its first real action. Verified live: an isolated test confirmed the self-rm path resolves correctly and ONBOARDING stays unexpanded in the generated file (read from the real environment at run time).

⚓ ☃
title: tmux-session.sh: self-cleanup follow-up to the real command-substitution bug fix
